steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Why write a sonnet?: Traditionally about love. Using sonnet form signals: this is serious, this is about love, this connects to poetic tradition. | Golden Rule: Naming a technique scores zero marks. You must explain its EFFECT. | Top Tip: In poetry analysis questions, AO2 (language, form, structure) typically carries 30-36 marks. Name the technique, quote precisely, then explain the effect — this three-step sequence is the minimum for each analytical point. Aim for 3-4 developed technique discussions in a 30-mark response.
